ceu: ✦ The square between Mars and Uranus

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between routine and conversations. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between romance and money. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between family and your image. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between money and friendships. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your image and your career. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Spend five minutes in silence before going to sleep.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your career and relationships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Set aside an hour without interruptions for what matters most.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Teach someone something you know well.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The square between Mars and Uranus creates some tension between relationships and family. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Review debts, loans or shared accounts calmly.
